name: xuanxue-cabinet
description: Кабинет школы тайцзицюань «Сюань-Сюэ» — монорепо (api, web, shared).

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev --workspace=api" "npm run dev --workspace=web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=web && npm run build --workspace=api
scripts.test: node scripts/check-vitest-coverage-ratchet.mjs shared && npm run test --workspace=api && node scripts/check-vitest-coverage-ratchet.mjs web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=api && npm run typecheck --workspace=web
scripts.gates: node scripts/check-coverage-ratchet.mjs && node scripts/check-eslint-ratchet.mjs && node scripts/check-jscpd-ratchet.mjs && node scripts/check-file-size-ratchet.mjs && node scripts/check-robot-phrases.mjs && node scripts/check-route-collisions.mjs && node scripts/check-card-list-gap.mjs && node scripts/check-write-then-reload.mjs && node scripts/check-name-collisions.mjs && node scripts/check-ownership-e2e.mjs && node scripts/check-outbound-timeout.mjs && node scripts/check-adr-numbers.mjs && node scripts/check-shared-exports.mjs && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && node scripts/check-env-example.mjs && node scripts/check-pwa.mjs && node scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs
